name: The Reef House Palm Cove
positioning: Adults-only, colonial-style retreat directly across from the beach in Palm Cove, a 25-minute drive north of Cairns international airport (officially The Reef House Adults Retreat)
best_for: Adults wanting a relaxation escape across from the beach
Travelers who want spa time, wellness classes and included activities
Travelers basing themselves near the Great Barrier Reef and the Daintree Rainforest

facts.text: Palm Cove Beach is a 25-minute drive north of Cairns international airport.
In the small seaside village of Palm Cove, everything you need is within walking distance.
Palm Cove is in close proximity to the Great Barrier Reef and the Daintree Rainforest.
All facilities, pools, day spa, restaurant and services are dedicated to house guests.
The accommodation is in an elegant colonial style.
A daily poolside butler service includes cool towels and local tropical sorbet.
Day Spa treatments can be tailored and use Phytomer and Waterlily products.
Spa Director Isabelle Neil was previously Managing Director of the first privately owned Christian Dior Spa, on Saint Maarten.
Activities include beachfront yoga, poolside stretch and breathe classes and aqua aerobics.
A Sleep Support Guide is provided in-room on arrival.
The Brigadier's Lounge Honesty Bar is a tradition originating from Brigadier Thomson's Officers Mess.
Breakfast is served overlooking the Coral Sea.

highlights.text: The Reef House provides relaxation escapes exclusively for adults.
The Reef House sits directly across from the beach in Palm Cove.
The Reef House Day Spa is exclusively available to house guests.
The Reef House has a tranquillity pool and a heated mineral pool.
Culture Connection offers expert talks on Indigenous culture.

considerations.text: The Reef House is a cashless hotel; payment is by credit card or charged to the room.
Spa treatments included with an Escape's Day Spa voucher must be booked at least two weeks before arrival.
All inclusions are subject to seasonal change.
